title: Peruvian Stuffed Rocoto Peppers
description: A vegetarian twist on a traditional Peruvian dish, this recipe fills tender rocoto peppers with a flavorful mixture of yellow rice, beef alternative, and spices.
instructions: 2. Cut off the tops of the rocoto peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
3. In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add garlic, aji amarillo pepper powder, and rocoto pepper paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
5. Stir in yellow rice, beef alternative, and dried relleno peppers. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Fill the rocoto peppers with the rice mixture and place them in a baking dish.
7. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
8. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
9. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
